details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path (lines 240-247); emit_context (lines 568-585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering, including the post-symlink-resolution check, was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths such as .git/config, .env, .netrc, .aws/credentials, or symlinked sensitive files can be read and inlined into model-visible context, leaking credentials and Git metadata.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of being supplied through command-scoped http.extraHeader.
  WHY: The token appears in process arguments, temporary Git configuration, diagnostics, exceptions, and workflow logs, reversing the credential-free-remote contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 542-589); clone/push call sites (lines 601, 624, 767, 883, 919) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick Git operations use token-bearing URLs while other memory operations use unauthenticated raw Git against a credential-free origin.
  WHY: Tokens leak through argv, remote configuration, and diagnostics, while `persist-credentials: false` causes branch probes, pushes, clones, and memory updates to fail silently.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: MAX_TARGET_PATHS = 256 and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES = 1024 removed; emit_context loop at lines 568-720 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Path-count, path-length, and missing-marker accounting limits were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted input can provide thousands of paths whose markers are not charged to used_bytes, exhausting the prompt budget and breaking edit attempts.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: argument parser (lines 95-114) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while multiple callers still pass it.
  WHY: The catch-all parser branch exits 2 before writing configuration, preventing broker-backed Codex phases from starting.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: model_providers.openrouter section (lines 258-264) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated provider configuration hardcodes `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` instead of using MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_BASE_URL.
  WHY: Any generated configuration that reaches Codex routes traffic around the loopback broker and its model, token, request, and price controls.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: review_blocked_* helpers (deleted, previously lines 972-1377) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Twelve review-blocked helper functions were deleted without replacement while consumers still invoke them.
  WHY: Approval requests, approval status checks, consumed markers, successor intents, and terminal review-blocked actions silently fail or return command-not-found, leaving the state machine stalled.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: git_with_github_auth (deleted, previously lines 493-508); scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2014 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded judge-fix push still calls the deleted `git_with_github_auth` helper.
  WHY: The `[judge-fix]` commit cannot be pushed, so the review-blocked judge remains unresolved.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (line 766), gh_pr_with_all_comments GraphQL (lines 833-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment JSON no longer includes `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer and approval-authority checks cannot identify trusted commenters or validate approval comments, even if the deleted helpers are restored.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 555-564) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` returns a header and disabled marker instead of `""`.
  WHY: `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES=0` no longer disables targeted context without consuming prompt budget, and contract tests fail.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: import block (lines 29-37) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, both removed from the implementation.
  WHY: Test collection fails with ImportError before any targeted-context test runs.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: bare model_provider_broker_start at lines 1737, 3198, 4540; MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK set at line 27 and final-attempt model switch at lines 2323-2324 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The three implement workflow broker-start sites do not authorize MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK.
  WHY: The final retry switches to the fallback model, but the broker rejects it as unauthorized.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 568-720) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Only raw file bytes are counted toward max_bytes; headers, footers, markers, and summaries are not.
  WHY: Rendered output can exceed the documented hard byte cap.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The pre_assembled_static.txt protection no longer detects staged deletions or restores staged modifications and additions.
  WHY: AI-staged destructive changes to the protected file can survive into the commit.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py: BrokerState.reserve_request (lines 185-195) and BrokerPolicy._bounded_token_limit (lines 140-146) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Default output-token reservations accumulate for the broker session and are never released.
  WHY: Four default-sized requests can exhaust the total token budget and cause HTTP 429 responses despite the request-count budget remaining available.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 571-572 stat, 612-613 open) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: OSError guards around stat() and fallback open() were removed.
  WHY: A file disappearing between checks can abort the entire context build instead of skipping that file.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: "Validate immutable workflow support source" steps at lines 899-912 and 1058-1071 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Post-merge validation requires workflow_repository and workflow_sha values that are empty for workflow_dispatch runs.
  WHY: Legitimate workflow-dispatch-triggered merged-PR runs fail closed before post-merge validate dispatch and force-poll execute.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config (line 100) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `local cfg=…` uses tab indentation while the surrounding function uses spaces.
  WHY: Bash behavior is unaffected, but the inconsistency makes future shellcheck-baseline review harder.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch line 140 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `local token="${GH_TOKEN:-}"` is declared but unused.
  WHY: The dead variable misleadingly suggests that the function authenticates Git operations.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
